identity.title: ALMA-IMF. I. Investigating the origin of stellar masses: Introduction to the Large Program and first results

paper_type_evidence.quote: One of the breakthroughs expected from ALMA, which is the basis of our Cycle 5 ALMA-IMF Large Program, is the question of the origin of the initial mass function (IMF) of stars.

The ALMA-IMF Large Program (PIs: Motte, Ginsburg, Louvet, Sanhueza) is a survey of 15 nearby Galactic protoclusters observed at matched sensitivity and physical resolution that aims for statistically meaningful results on the origin of the IMF (see below).

why_this_data.value: Selected 15 massive ATLASGAL protoclusters at 2-5.5 kpc in ALMA Bands 3 and 6 to achieve matched ~2000 au spatial resolution and subsolar (~0.15-0.2 M_sun) point-mass sensitivity while covering parsec-scale clouds and key kinematic, ionized, and COM spectral lines.

evidence.loc: The most massive protocluster clouds of the Milky Way
evidence.quote: In order to reach an angular resolution of a couple of thousand au and a subsolar mass sensitivity with reasonable ALMA integration times, while reaching the exceptional W43 mini-starburst region at 5.5 kpc (cite: nguyen11a), we applied a distance-limited criterion of $d\leq 5.5~\mbox{kpc}$.
We chose the 1.3 mm and 3 mm spectral bands primarily for their mostly optically thin emission in (massive) cores and their relatively well-defined dust opacities.

why_this_method.value: Used both 1.3 mm/3 mm continuum flux ratios and H41α recombination line surface densities to overcome mid-IR classification ambiguities, and used getsf on line-free (cleanest) continuum images to separate round cores from filaments and free-free peaks.

referee_caveats_inferred: Core temperatures are simplified to a bimodal assumption (20 K for normal cores, 75 K for the 10 brightest cores with S > 400 mJy at 3.9 kpc), which could artificially distort the high-mass end of the core mass distribution and the cloud-mass vs. max-core-mass correlation.

The 12m-only recovered mass (M^recovered_1.3mm) depends on the uv-coverage and Largest Angular Scale (LAS), which varies by a factor of ~2.7-2.8 across the sample; absence of 7m and Total Power combination limits conclusions on intermediate-scale (0.1 pc) gas concentration.
In the cleanest images of line-rich regions like W51 and W43, the effective line-free continuum bandwidth is small, degrading point-mass sensitivity at the low-mass end.
